messages:
Tara: Quick thread  post-launch community blitz for the OSS refapp went live this morning. Need a short benchmark narrative for the blog hero, a 2-line social stat, and a follow-up tutorial email. Who can take the pieces?
Jon: I can do the benchmark hero blurb. Early numbers: with cache+batching we see ~22% lower p95 and ~18% cost per 1k tokens. Will craft an eye-catching one-liner + 1-paragraph context.
Leah: I'll draft the tutorial follow-up email and the short code snippet for the post (one-command deploy). Want the email to link to the repo, assets, and a 3-min demo clip.
Marco: I'll handle the social stat and quick A/B for CTAs: CTA A = "Try the refapp" CTA B = "See the benchmarks". Also will spin up a short GIF of the deploy flow for Twitter.
Tara: Love it. Jon  please keep the hero blurb under 40 words and include the test setup note (2k token prompts, n=200 runs). Leah  include an RSVP link for office hours in the email.
Jon: Draft: "Redwood refapp: 22% lower p95 latency and 18% lower serving cost with caching + batching (2k tokens, 200-run avg). Repro steps and configs in the appendix." Posting in 30m for review.
Leah: Email draft queued: short + long variants. Short version points to GIF, bench slide, and repo. Long has step-by-step. Will post copy here for review in 2 hours.
Marco: GIF ready (2s)  uploading to /assets/refapp-deploy.gif and scheduling two tweets: noon (dev audience) and 6pm (platform leads).
publish-bot: Scheduled: "Launch blog post amplification" -> tweets queued at 12:00 and 18:00.
Tara: Routing note  registration form should tag attendees with interest_level and add to list "oss-launch-attendees"; Leah, can you add that to the confirmation email?
Leah: Yep. Adding HubSpot field instructions to the email copy.
Tara: Great work team  small follow-up: measure registrant -> watcher conversion and repo stars over 7 days. Closing thread, will surface analytics next week. :rocket:
